method: Manual visual inspection of the downloaded card images and contact sheet. Mechanics are paraphrased; no large text blocks are transcribed. Icon identities that could not be confidently resolved are described generically.

missions.title: Aid Our Allies
missions.objectivePattern: Spend influence while using a recovery service at a named space.
missions.progressRequirement: One qualifying spend; threshold at least 1.
missions.rewardPattern: Reveal a wargear option and acquire it at zero cost, with an extra charge for charged gear.
missions.difficultySignals: Requires currency, routing, and a specific service space.
missions.playerChoiceElement: How much influence to spend and whether to route to the service.
missions.notes: Strong economy-to-item conversion mission.

missions.title: Bring Him to Justice
missions.objectivePattern: Secretly mark another character, then share their space during your turn.
missions.progressRequirement: Single contact with the marked target.
missions.rewardPattern: Take one non-relic asset from the target.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Target choice may become stale if unreachable.
missions.difficultySignals: Distance and opponent movement create variable difficulty.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Select target on acquisition and plan an interception.
missions.notes: High rivalry value; unsuitable for pure co-op without substitution.

missions.title: Cleanse Holy Terra
missions.objectivePattern: Win against an enemy or nemesis on any space with a specified threat color.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a permanent stat increase, with a fallback alternate stat if already capped.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose which matching fight to pursue.
missions.notes: Broad enough to remain actionable while still shaping route choice.

missions.title: Cleanse the Hive World
missions.objectivePattern: Win a battle in a named board region.
missions.rewardPattern: Keep the mission as a completed asset or ally; it grants a numeric skill bonus.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route into the region and select a fight.
missions.notes: Reward transforms the mission card into a persistent upgrade.

missions.title: Deus Mechanicus
missions.objectivePattern: End movement on a named fabrication space while carrying influence.
missions.progressRequirement: One arrival with at least one currency.
missions.rewardPattern: Reveal wargear and acquire one for free; charged items gain an extra charge.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route timing and reward selection.
missions.notes: A destination pilgrimage with a concrete loot payoff.

missions.title: Eliminate the Enemy
missions.objectivePattern: Accumulate character tokens on the mission; card implies repeated qualifying accomplishments.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a named status/resource, or a level if already holding it.
missions.timing: Whenever the unspecified qualifying trigger adds tokens.
missions.enemyDependence: Implied by theme, but trigger text is not visible beyond token objective.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Long-horizon pursuit.
missions.notes: The source image does not visibly explain how tokens are earned; rules context may be external.

missions.title: Face the Enemy
missions.objectivePattern: Begin a turn with at least one trophy/experience card from three distinct threat decks.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain another completed mission.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Inventory pressure may encourage holding trophies instead of spending them.
missions.difficultySignals: Requires cross-deck diversity rather than raw count.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route across threat colors and delay trophy conversion.
missions.notes: Good collection-set objective with opportunity cost.

missions.title: Fight to the End
missions.objectivePattern: Reach the beginning of a turn at one life.
missions.rewardPattern: Optionally reset life to starting value; doing so also grants one extra life.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Extremely high elimination risk before completion.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose whether to flirt with defeat and whether to cash the recovery.
missions.notes: Dramatic comeback mission; can invite degenerate self-damage play.

missions.title: Find the Traitor
missions.objectivePattern: Secretly mark the player to your right, then occupy their space.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain influence; reduced reward if the target has multiple corruption cards.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Reward degrades based on target state.
missions.difficultySignals: Opponent movement and seating determine difficulty.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Plan an intercept; target is fixed rather than chosen.
missions.notes: Clear rivalry pressure with a state-dependent payout.

missions.title: Fleet Resupply
missions.objectivePattern: Buy at least one wargear card using a specific purchase ability at a named space.
missions.rewardPattern: Immediate relocation to another outer/middle space instead of resolving movement normally.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Requires spending and can strand the player if purchase options are poor.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose purchase and destination.
missions.notes: Turns shopping into tempo and route manipulation.

missions.title: Honour and Duty
missions.objectivePattern: Mark qualifying red-threat spaces, then defeat threats while on marked spaces.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a stat/status resource, or a completed mission if already capped.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Tokens require setup and can pull the player into danger.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Select which danger spaces to mark.
missions.notes: A richer multi-step hunt than a generic kill count.

missions.title: Humanity's Champion
missions.objectivePattern: Begin a phase affiliated with four or more groups.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a persistent champion status that matches one affiliation.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Build toward broad affiliation coverage.
missions.notes: Build-composition mission rather than board-space mission.

missions.title: Hurry the Advance
missions.objectivePattern: Mark two threat spaces of different colors, then visit each and collect its token.
missions.rewardPattern: Roll a die and recover life equal to the result.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Marked destinations may become strategically inconvenient.
missions.enemyDependence: None required, though spaces may be dangerous.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose destinations and route order.
missions.notes: Excellent board-routing objective with readable map markers.

missions.title: Infiltrate the Eldar
missions.objectivePattern: Win a battle against a specified enemy family.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain one permanent stat.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Hunt a matching target.
missions.notes: Simple and clear, but draw-dependent.

missions.title: Kill the Tyranids
missions.objectivePattern: Win a battle against a specified enemy family.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain one permanent stat.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Hunt a matching target.
missions.notes: Near-duplicate family hunt; replayability depends on encounter distribution.

missions.title: Liberate the Forge World
missions.objectivePattern: Win a battle in a named region.
missions.rewardPattern: Keep completed card as an ally/persistent bonus to a skill.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route into region and pick engagement.
missions.notes: Mirrors another region-liberation mission with a different stat reward.

missions.title: Make the Pilgrimage
missions.objectivePattern: Spend influence while resolving a prayer-like ability at a named shrine.
missions.rewardPattern: Discard one corruption card per influence spent.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Consumes currency and requires corruption to maximize value.
missions.difficultySignals: Specific location, currency, and state dependence.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose timing and spend amount.
missions.notes: A cleansing mission whose payoff scales with investment.

missions.title: Navigate the Phantom Stars
missions.objectivePattern: Begin a phase in a named region.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain influence, draw several wargear cards, and buy any number while discarding the rest.
missions.difficultySignals: Region travel plus ability to capitalize on market access.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route timing and multi-card purchase decisions.
missions.notes: Large shop burst reward can materially swing loadouts.

missions.title: Never Surrender
missions.objectivePattern: Lose four battles while holding the mission, adding a token per loss.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain one level.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Repeated battle losses carry their normal costs.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Whether to pursue risky fights or let progress happen naturally.
missions.notes: Catch-up design, but can reward deliberate losing.

missions.title: Patrol the Sector
missions.objectivePattern: Mark three starting-area spaces; remove tokens by visiting them, but replace tokens when losing battles.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain one chosen attribute.
missions.timing: Start phase placement, visits, and battle losses.
missions.locationDependence: Three marked spaces in the starting region.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose patrol route and risk exposure.
missions.notes: One of the strongest route-loop structures in the set.

missions.title: Pilgrimage to Terra
missions.objectivePattern: End movement on a named palace space while carrying a required resource/status.
missions.rewardPattern: Keep as completed mission or ally; provides a numeric skill bonus.
missions.difficultySignals: Specific inner destination and prerequisite resource.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route and timing.
missions.notes: Classic pilgrimage destination with a durable payoff.

missions.title: Psychic Training
missions.objectivePattern: Discard a power card at a named training space.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a stat/status resource or retain the mission as an ally that increases a limit.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Which card to sacrifice and which reward branch applies.
missions.notes: Good convert-an-item objective with meaningful cost.

missions.title: Purge the Death World
missions.objectivePattern: Win a battle in a named hazardous region.
missions.rewardPattern: Keep as completed mission or ally for a numeric skill bonus.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route and target selection.
missions.notes: Same reusable chassis as other region-battle missions.

missions.title: Report to the Blackstone Fortress
missions.objectivePattern: Spend influence while resolving a named space ability.
missions.rewardPattern: Keep completed card or ally and gain a numeric skill bonus.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route and spend timing.
missions.notes: Travel-and-pay structure with durable reward.

missions.title: Report to the Fortress World
missions.objectivePattern: Resolve a named ability at a named fortress space.
missions.rewardPattern: Take another turn after the next experience phase.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Plan arrival to exploit the extra turn.
missions.notes: Tempo reward can be stronger than its simple objective suggests.

missions.title: Show Them No Mercy
missions.objectivePattern: End movement on another player's space.
missions.rewardPattern: Take all heretic/traitor trophy cards from that player.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Reward can be zero if target holds none.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose target based on route and trophy value.
missions.notes: Rivalry-only payoff; needs co-op alternative.

missions.title: Spread the Light
missions.objectivePattern: Mark red and blue threat spaces; both markers must be collected by any players visiting them.
missions.rewardPattern: Roll for a variable power-card draw.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Relies partly on other players' routes.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Select marker placement; table can coordinate or deny progress.
missions.notes: Good shared-table mission where other players can advance the owner.

missions.title: Stop the Waaagh!
missions.objectivePattern: Win a battle against a specified enemy family.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain one permanent stat.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Hunt matching target.
missions.notes: Simple family hunt; mechanically repetitive beside its siblings.

missions.title: Survey the Area
missions.objectivePattern: Mark one blue and one yellow threat space; collect both tokens when any player visits.
missions.rewardPattern: Roll for variable influence.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Marker placement and table coordination.
missions.notes: Parallel to the shared red/blue route mission with a currency payoff.

missions.title: Take Initiative
missions.objectivePattern: Accumulate three character tokens; source image does not visibly state the token-earning trigger.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain influence or keep as a completed mission and draw a large power-card hand.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose immediate currency or delayed/alternate card value.
missions.notes: Token source likely depends on external rule context; marked uncertain.

missions.title: The Emperor's Justice
missions.objectivePattern: End movement with a corrupted player on your space.
missions.progressRequirement: One interception of a qualifying target.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a status/resource; if already held, force target relocation or inflict life loss.
missions.difficultySignals: Requires another player with a specific state.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Target selection and reward branch.
missions.notes: Strong rivalry pressure with punitive completion choice.

missions.title: Train the Guard
missions.objectivePattern: End movement on a named training field while carrying a required resource/status.
missions.rewardPattern: Keep as completed mission or ally and gain a numeric skill bonus.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route and timing.
missions.notes: Straightforward destination mission.

missions.title: Travel the Stars
missions.objectivePattern: Spend influence while resolving a named crossroads ability.
missions.rewardPattern: Gain a status/resource or, if already held, gain influence.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Route, spend amount, and reward branch.
missions.notes: Compact travel-and-pay mission.

missions.title: Watch Your Back
missions.objectivePattern: Secretly mark the player to your left, then share their space.
missions.rewardPattern: Take influence or one random power card from the target.
missions.failureOrPenaltyPattern: Target may be hard to reach or poor in both resources.
missions.playerChoiceElement: Choose reward based on target inventory.
missions.notes: Rivalry mirror of the right-neighbor pursuit mission.
